benefit_text: The scheme offers margin money subsidy for new micro‑enterprises. General category contributes 10% and receives 15% subsidy in urban areas, 25% in rural. Special category contributes 5% and receives 25% urban, 35% rural. Upgradation loans get 15% subsidy.
who_can_apply: Individuals aged 18 years or older can apply. There is no income ceiling. General, special and other categories such as SC, ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex‑servicemen, transgenders, differently abled, NER and aspirational districts are eligible.
documents: Required documents include caste certificate, special category certificate if needed, rural area certificate, project report, and education or skill development certificate.
how_to_apply: Visit the official PMEGP website, click Apply under New Unit, fill the online form, save data, upload required documents and submit.
